tasks.title: Fix subject and mask prompts
tasks.description: Subject and mask prompts are finished. Further stress-testing is tracked separately.

tasks.title: Build and review 100-note hierarchy
tasks.description:
Produce a useful 100-note hierarchy accepted by the user in browsing review.
Frontier-based: 200-note candidate is cycle-free; browsing quality remains open.
Vector-space: 100-note build and larger-model test completed; quality problems remain.
Neither approach selected; subject-generation errors remain unresolved.

tasks.title: Test hierarchy across more topics
tasks.description:
Validate browsing quality at 200, 300, 500 and ~1–2k notes, adding note ordering and scalable construction.
Frontier-based 200-note candidate is cycle-free, not yet accepted. New generation awaits prompt stress-testing; 100-note acceptance remains open.

tasks.title: Define node sort score
tasks.description:
Define and validate one sorting score per note within a hierarchy node.
The candidate passed its browsing audit and is frozen for the next build. Validation in an actual hierarchy remains open.

tasks.title: Prepare pilot training data
tasks.description:
Prepare teacher subject hierarchies and a separate evaluation set for the subjects-only larger fine-tuning pilot.
Awaits selected teachers. The preliminary experiment uses existing data.

tasks.title: Choose model through larger fine-tuning pilot
tasks.description:
Compare untuned and trained subject quality, returned hierarchies, runtime and cost to inform distilled-model selection. Three continuing student runs on one 96GB RTX PRO 6000 use one subject example per note once, with validation at 200/400/600/800/1,000 notes and dynamic subject evaluation batching from token lengths and a frozen per-GPU memory budget; masks are excluded from this pilot.
Awaits pilot data and larger-run preparation. Confirm weight-release permission before selection.

tasks.title: Generate full training data
tasks.description:
Generate the full mask training data for the distilled model, plus any agreed additional outputs.
Starts only after successful 500-note hierarchy validation and teacher selection; training volume remains undecided.

tasks.title: Distill and package the model
tasks.description:
Train the distilled model on Vast.ai and release loadable weights, usage instructions and evaluation results.
Awaits model selection and full training data; unseen-note quality and runtime must be checked.

tasks.title: Choose notes for launch hierarchy
tasks.description:
Freeze a launch corpus of 2,000–5,000 English kind-1 top-level posts, excluding replies and quote notes.
Select from the collected corpus after resource estimates; the final selection remains open.

tasks.title: Check distilled-model build time and cost
tasks.description:
Assess whether the distilled model and chosen construction/sorting workflow can build a launch-scale hierarchy within time and budget.
Awaits the packaged model, selected corpus and scale measurements. This is a model-track check, not a release gate.

tasks.title: Test hierarchy with the distilled model
tasks.description:
Build and review a sample hierarchy from the distilled model’s outputs to validate browsing and the complete pipeline.
Awaits the packaged model and broader-corpus validation. Passing this gates the model release.

tasks.title: Build launch hierarchy snapshot
tasks.description:
Produce a fully automated 2–5k-note launch snapshot, with runnable code, architecture, serving instructions and a scalability/continual-update roadmap.
Awaits validated construction, corpus selection, teachers and budget approval. Completion requires the user’s browsing acceptance; no manual repair.

tasks.title: Define Nostr hierarchy protocol
tasks.description:
Agree the Nostr protocol for opening snapshots and browsing hierarchy nodes and ordered notes.
Protocol proposals are under review. Service implementation and client integration await agreement.

tasks.title: Build and test hierarchy service code
tasks.description:
Deliver service code that serves a saved hierarchy snapshot through the Nostr protocol, with end-to-end local tests and serving instructions.
Implementation awaits the protocol; testing needs the reviewed 100-note snapshot. Hosted operation is optional.

tasks.title: Build Notedeck hierarchy browser
tasks.description:
Deliver a Notedeck hierarchy browser on the user’s fork, integrated with the Nostr service.
Browser UI is approved and committed; service integration awaits protocol agreement and service implementation.

tasks.title: Launch public hierarchy
tasks.description:
Publish the accepted snapshot, generation code and architecture, tested serving instructions, scalability roadmap and Notedeck fork branch by October 18.
The model release and hosted demo are optional.

tasks.title: Compare teachers
tasks.description:
Select teachers by comparing subject/mask quality, cost, speed, terms and resulting hierarchies on the same notes.
Candidate testing continues; no teachers selected. Final selection awaits prompt stress-testing and the node sort score requirements.

tasks.title: Prepare training code for the fine-tuning pilot
tasks.description:
Training, evaluation and deployment setup is ready for the preliminary experiment.
This does not complete larger-pilot preparation, candidate evaluation or model selection.

tasks.title: Assess full hierarchy-build resources
tasks.description:
Estimate teacher generation and chosen construction/sorting resources for the 2–5k-note release.
Awaits construction measurements; include HDBSCAN only if selected. Keep optional model-track estimates separate so they do not block the release estimate.

tasks.title: Assess HDBSCAN at launch scale
tasks.description:
Assess whether HDBSCAN can form mask-vector groups at launch scale within time, memory and budget limits.
Required only if HDBSCAN is selected; its use remains undecided.

tasks.title: Measure SSE and hierarchy-construction costs
tasks.description:
Measure SSE and the hierarchy-construction stages used by the chosen workflow, including time, memory and cost.
Separate node-title generation is conditional; the production workflow remains undecided.

tasks.title: Fix and validate node-title prompt
tasks.description:
Node-title prompt work is complete for the earlier HDBSCAN/TRUE build.
Required only if the chosen workflow uses separate node-title generation; that choice remains open.

tasks.title: Recover missing node memberships
tasks.description:
Recover masks missing from HDBSCAN-produced nodes and validate relevant-content coverage beyond the Coffee/Tea test.
Awaits the workflow choice; needed only if HDBSCAN is used. Coverage remains required for any workflow.

tasks.title: Handle node equivalence and TRUE cycles
tasks.description:
Provisional node-equivalence and TRUE-cycle handling is implemented for the earlier HDBSCAN/TRUE hierarchy.
Historical work; current merging and conflict decisions belong to the 100-note investigation.

tasks.title: Collapse equal-note navigation steps
tasks.description:
Skip child navigation steps when their note sets equal their parent’s.
The earlier implementation awaits validation; reuse in the current hierarchy is undecided.

tasks.title: Order notes within each node
tasks.description:
Implement and validate note ordering within each hierarchy node.
The sorting candidate is frozen for the next build; production integration and hierarchy browsing validation remain. Recursive sorting and parent-child score transfer are out of scope.

tasks.title: Implement and validate the launch-scale build
tasks.description:
Implement and validate the chosen workflow at launch scale, including cosine-filtered relationship checks.
Awaits broader-corpus validation and construction measurements. HDBSCAN and separate title generation remain conditional.

tasks.title: Run preliminary 100-note fine-tuning experiment
tasks.description:
Compare trained and untuned subject-and-mask outputs in the preliminary 100-note pilot.
Training runs are complete; baseline mask generation and semantic review remain unfinished. This informs the larger pilot, not final model selection.

tasks.title: Stress-test prompts
tasks.description:
Stress-test prompts before broader-corpus generation and final teacher selection.
Subject-generation tests still expose missing relationships and incorrect parent links; new broader-corpus generation remains on hold. Corpus preparation and teacher comparisons can continue.
